titulo: Shopping, clothes, colors and demonstratives: This, that and that one over there

aula.objetivo: Name clothes and colors, point at things with «este, esse, aquele», ask the price, say your size and buy something in a shop.

sessao.titulo: This, that and that one over there

blocos.titulo: Este, esse, aquele: pointing at things
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: Portuguese has three levels of distance. «Este / esta» is near the speaker; «esse / essa» is near the listener or a little farther; «aquele / aquela» is far from both. Plurals: «estes, estas; esses, essas; aqueles, aquelas». STEP 2: they agree with the noun: «esta camisa», «esse casaco», «aquelas calças». STEP 3: in everyday Brazilian speech «esse / essa» often takes the place of «este / esta», even for things in your hand: «Quanto custa esse casaco?» «Este» is common in writing, formal speech and some regions. Both are right. STEP 4: when you do not name the thing, use the neutral words «isto, isso, aquilo», which have no gender and no plural: «O que é isso?» (What is this/that?). Never put «isto / isso / aquilo» before a noun. STEP 5: after «de» and «em» they contract, as «no» and «na» did: de + esse = desse, em + esse = nesse, em + aquela = naquela. So: «a cor desse casaco», «Moro naquela rua». The words «aqui» (here), «aí» (there, near you) and «lá» or «ali» (over there) go along with the three levels.
blocos.comparacao: English has only two levels, this and that. Portuguese has three: this (near me), that (near you) and that over there (far from both). In speech, though, many Brazilians use just two, «esse» and «aquele». Also, English «this» or «that» alone can be a pronoun («What is that?»); in Portuguese the pronoun for an unnamed thing is a separate word: «isso».

exemplos.ru: A cor desse vestido é rosa.
exemplos.pt: The color of that dress is pink.

erros.motivo: The demonstrative agrees in gender: «casaco» is masculine.
«Isso» is used alone, never before a noun.
The demonstrative must also be plural.

blocos.enunciado: Imagine a shop with many clothes. Point at things near you, near the listener and far away, and describe them: «Esta camisa é amarela. Essa calça é cinza. Aquele casaco marrom é bonito.» Make at least six sentences with different colors.
blocos.exemplo: Esta camisa é amarela. Essa calça é cinza. Aquele casaco marrom é bonito. Aquelas camisetas rosa são caras.

blocos.enunciado: Name six clothes in Portuguese with their articles (o, a), then give each a color that agrees: «a camisa branca», «o sapato preto».
